sentences.text: Dear Ms. Young,
sentences.label: Chào hỏi

sentences.text: Thank you for your e-mail dated June 5. I was very concerned to learn about the problem that you have with your book order.
sentences.label: Cảm ơn / tóm tắt vấn đề

sentences.text: At the time you placed an order for the book, our computer showed that there was one book left. However, that turned out to be wrong.
sentences.label: Nêu sự cố & giải thích lý do

sentences.text: On behalf of my store, I would like to apologize for the problem with your book.
sentences.label: Mission 1: Xin lỗi

sentences.text: Currently, we don't have any more copies of the book at the store. Would you give us a call or visit if you would like to receive a refund?
sentences.label: Mission 2: Câu hỏi 1

sentences.text: Otherwise, if you give me some time, I will contact the publisher and find out if they still have any copies. If that's the case, could you wait a few more days?
sentences.label: Mission 3: Câu hỏi 2

sentences.text: Once again, I hope you will accept my apologies for any inconvenience I may have caused.
sentences.label: Câu kết

sentences.text:
Sincerely yours,
Customer Support
sentences.label: Lời chào cuối thư

exercises.explanation: Khối 'Nêu sự cố & giải thích lý do' đứng TRƯỚC lời xin lỗi — người đọc hiểu chuyện gì đã xảy ra rồi mới nghe xin lỗi. Hai câu hỏi được tách thành hai đoạn riêng, mỗi đoạn một phương án cho khách chọn.

exercises.intro: Thư quản lý nhà hàng xin lỗi khách về bữa tối hỏng. Chú ý: có một câu chỉ là xã giao, không phải mission.
labels: Cảm ơn / tóm tắt vấn đề
Mission 1: Xin lỗi lỗi thứ nhất
Mission 2: Xin lỗi lỗi thứ hai

sentences.text: Dear Ms. Benson,
sentences.label: Chào hỏi

sentences.text: Thank you for taking the time to write to us about your dinner last Saturday.
sentences.label: Cảm ơn / tóm tắt vấn đề

sentences.text: I would like to apologize for the long wait before your table was ready.
sentences.label: Mission 1: Xin lỗi lỗi thứ nhất

sentences.text: I am also very sorry that two of your dishes arrived cold and that one order was incorrect.
sentences.label: Mission 2: Xin lỗi lỗi thứ hai

sentences.text: To compensate for the inconvenience, we would like to offer you a complimentary dinner for six on your next visit.
sentences.label: Mission 3: Đề nghị bồi thường

sentences.text: We greatly value customers who have been with us for many years.
sentences.label: Câu xã giao (không bắt buộc)

sentences.text: We have full assurance that this will not happen again.
sentences.label: Câu kết

sentences.text:
Sincerely,
The Copper Kettle Restaurant
sentences.label: Lời chào cuối thư

exercises.explanation: Hai lời xin lỗi phải nhắm vào HAI lỗi khác nhau, mỗi lỗi một câu riêng — như vậy giám khảo mới đếm được 2 mission. Câu 'We greatly value customers...' là xã giao: bỏ đi thư vẫn đủ mission, nhưng có nó thì thư ấm hơn.

sentences.text: Thank you for your interest in Greenfield Fitness Centre following our newspaper advertisement.

sentences.text: Since you work until seven, I would recommend our premium plan, which gives you full pool access in the evening.
sentences.label: Mission 4: Khuyến nghị

sentences.text: Please e-mail me as soon as possible if you would like to arrange a visit.
sentences.label: Câu kết

sentences.text:
Best regards,
Greenfield Fitness Centre

sentences.text: Dear Ms. Marchetti,
sentences.label: Chào hỏi

sentences.text: Thank you for letting us know about the business cards you collected yesterday.
sentences.label: Cảm ơn / tóm tắt vấn đề

sentences.text: When we checked our records, we found that an older version of your file had been sent to the press by mistake.
sentences.label: Nêu sự cố & giải thích lý do

sentences.text: I would like to apologize for printing your logo in the wrong colour.
sentences.label: Mission 1: Xin lỗi

sentences.text: We will reprint all five hundred cards in dark navy free of charge and have them ready by October 7.
sentences.label: Mission 2: Nêu cách khắc phục

sentences.text: Would you like us to deliver the corrected cards to your office, or would you prefer to collect them from the studio?
sentences.label: Mission 3: Đặt câu hỏi

sentences.text: Once again, please accept my sincere apology for the inconvenience caused.
sentences.label: Câu kết

sentences.text:
Yours sincerely,
Halcyon Print Studio
sentences.label: Lời chào cuối thư

exercises.explanation: Chú ý mission 2 có MỐC THỜI GIAN cụ thể (October 7) đặt trước hạn chót của khách (October 9). Lời hứa không có mốc thời gian là lời hứa suông.

sentences.text: Dear Facilities Management Team,
sentences.label: Chào hỏi

sentences.text: Thank you for informing us about the office move to the Vernon Building on November 3.
sentences.label: Cảm ơn / tóm tắt vấn đề

sentences.text: I have one item that needs special handling: a large format printer that is too heavy to be carried by one person.
sentences.label: Mission 1: Mô tả món đồ cần xử lý đặc biệt

sentences.text: Will the company provide movers to help with heavy equipment on the day?
sentences.label: Mission 2: Câu hỏi 1

sentences.text: Can we access the new office over the weekend to set up before Monday?
sentences.label: Mission 3: Câu hỏi 2

sentences.text: I am happy to help coordinate the move for my team if that would be useful.
sentences.label: Câu xã giao (không bắt buộc)

sentences.text: I look forward to hearing from you.
sentences.label: Câu kết

sentences.text:
Best regards,
Hoa Le — Marketing
sentences.label: Lời chào cuối thư

exercises.explanation: Câu 'I am happy to help coordinate...' không nằm trong Directions — nó là xã giao. Trong bài thi 10 phút, chỉ thêm câu xã giao khi bạn ĐÃ hoàn thành đủ mission và còn dư thời gian.

exercises.prompt: Các câu dưới đây đã bị xáo trộn. Sắp xếp lại thành một e-mail hoàn chỉnh.
items: Dear Mr. Nowak,
Thank you for your e-mail of February 8 concerning order #4471.
When we checked the shipment records, we found that the pallet had been stacked incorrectly at our warehouse.
I would like to apologize for the damage to eight of the twenty boxes.
Would you like us to send replacements by express delivery, or issue a credit note instead?
We have full assurance that this will not happen again.

Yours sincerely,
Vertex Paper Company
exercises.explanation: Trật tự chuẩn: Chào → Tóm tắt → Giải thích lý do → Xin lỗi → Câu hỏi → Câu kết → Ký tên. Lời giải thích luôn đứng trước lời xin lỗi, và câu hỏi luôn nằm sau lời xin lỗi.

exercises.prompt: Sắp xếp các câu thành e-mail hoàn chỉnh — thư quản lý toà nhà trả lời người thuê về hệ thống sưởi.
items: Dear Ms. Reyes,
Thank you for your e-mail about the heating in apartment 12B.
I would like to apologize for the delay in responding to the call you made on Friday.
Our engineer will visit on Wednesday between ten and twelve in the morning.
The repair will be carried out at no cost to you.
Please let me know if that time is not convenient.

Sincerely,
Brookside Property Management
exercises.explanation: Hai thông tin về việc sửa chữa (thời gian, chi phí) đứng liền nhau ở giữa thư. Câu kết luôn là câu mở đường cho phản hồi tiếp theo, đứng ngay trước lời chào cuối.

exercises.prompt: Sắp xếp các câu thành e-mail hoàn chỉnh — thư trường ngoại ngữ trả lời học viên về việc hoàn học phí.
items: Dear Ms. Ihara,
Thank you for your e-mail of January 22 regarding the Advanced Business English course.
I would like to apologize for the fact that no one has contacted you about your refund.
Your payment of 480 dollars will be returned to your account within ten working days.
Alternatively, if you would prefer, we can transfer the full amount to our February evening course at no extra charge.
Please let me know which option you would like.

Yours sincerely,
Milbrook Language School
exercises.explanation: Khi có phương án thay thế, dùng 'Alternatively' hoặc 'Otherwise' để nối — người đọc thấy ngay đây là lựa chọn thứ hai. Câu kết phải yêu cầu khách CHỌN, vì bạn vừa đưa ra hai đường.

exercises.prompt: Sắp xếp các câu thành e-mail hoàn chỉnh — thư khách hàng trả lời ngân hàng về giao dịch bất thường.
items: Dear Customer Support Team,
Thank you for your e-mail of July 3 about the two transactions on my account.
I can confirm that I did make both transactions on July 1.
Could you tell me the exact amounts of the two transactions in question?
Will the suspension affect my direct debits and standing orders?
I would appreciate an early reply so that my card can be reactivated.

Yours sincerely,
Adrian Cole
exercises.explanation: Câu xác nhận (mission 1) phải đứng TRƯỚC hai câu hỏi — trả lời điều người ta hỏi trước, rồi mới hỏi lại. Đảo ngược sẽ khiến thư trông như né tránh.

exercises.prompt: Sắp xếp các câu thành e-mail hoàn chỉnh — thư trung tâm cộng đồng trả lời khách hỏi thuê hội trường.
items: Dear Mr. Okoro,
Thank you for your interest in holding your company anniversary dinner at Ridgeway Community Centre.
Our main hall is available on December 12 at a rate of 120 dollars per hour.
Catering is available on site, and our kitchen can serve up to one hundred guests.
You are welcome to bring your own sound equipment, provided that it is set up before six in the evening.
As December is our busiest month, I would suggest booking as early as possible.

Best regards,
Ridgeway Community Centre
exercises.explanation: Ba câu trả lời giữ đúng thứ tự khách hỏi (giá → ăn uống → thiết bị âm thanh), rồi mới đến khuyến nghị. Giữ đúng thứ tự của đề là cách nhanh nhất để giám khảo tick đủ mission.
